summary.text: Skip Daly is a Democratic member of the Nevada State Senate who has represented District 13 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He previously served in the Nevada State Assembly from 2011 to 2014 and from 2016 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Skip Daly was born in Reno, Nevada, graduated from Reed High School, and earned an A.A. from Truckee Meadows Community College; his career experience includes working as a business manager with Laborers' Union Local 169.
He represented District 31 in the Nevada State Assembly from 2011 to 2014 and again from 2016 to 2020, when Jill Dickman succeeded him.
He assumed office in the Senate on November 9, 2022, succeeding Julia Ratti.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Senate Commerce and Labor (as vice chair), Senate Government Affairs, and Senate Legislative Operations and Elections (as vice chair) committees.
His opponents in the 2026 general election are Republican Matthew Buehler and Charlene Young of the Independent American Party.
